name: Ethan
bio: Ethan son of Kushaiah was a Levite of the Merarite clan. When David organized the Levites to carry the ark into Jerusalem with music and singing, Ethan was chosen as one of three chief singers, alongside Heman and Asaph, sounding bronze cymbals as the procession moved toward the city (1 Chronicles 15:16-19). He is a different figure from Ethan the Ezrahite, the namesake of Psalm 89.
